findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security
findings.evidence: Strict-Transport-Security was not present in the response.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS on HTTPS sites; choose max-age carefully.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.evidence: Content-Security-Policy was not present in the response.
findings.recommendation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy suited to the application.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy was not present in the response.
findings.recommendation: Consider strict-origin-when-cross-origin or a stricter policy.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.evidence: Permissions-Policy was not present in the response.
findings.recommendation: Set a Permissions-Policy appropriate to the features the site needs.

findings.title: Server header disclosed
findings.recommendation: Consider minimizing version/product details in the Server response header.
